name: Eira Harwick
original_name: エイラ・ハーウィック
source:
[i]"I decided to justify it by saying it wasn't my fault. And that made things a little easier, just like a drug."[/i]

[i]Grieving Rebel[/i]

The heroine's unique friend. She's lived with an unquenchable hatred deep in her heart, and her clothes speak to her rebellious spirit. Though she's equally scathing with the heroine, she is unquestionably her friend. Those feelings run deep enough to lead her into danger, and she doesn't shy away from even poisoning the man that hurt the heroine. 

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/kaleido/english/characters/?page=eira]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
